title: All Who Believe and Are Baptized
altTitles: He That Believes and Is Baptized
author: Thomas Hansen Kingo (1634-1703)
credit: Thomas Hansen Kingo, 1689.  Translation by George Alfred Taylor Rygh, 1909, alt.

tunes.name: Es ist das Heil uns Kommen Her

firstLine: All who believe and are baptized
verses: All who believe and are baptized
baptized into the death of Christ,
through Christ's redemption they shall stand
With one accord, O God, we pray:
Grant us to grow in grace each day
that by this sacrament we may
